summary: Noah Holdings filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing routine board changes: appointment of Tianjing Zhang as independent director, retirement of Cynthia Jinhong Meng, and re-designation of David Zhang as independent under HK Listing Rules. These are ordinary governance updates, not a special situation. Committee compositions were adjusted accordingly. The filing includes press releases and an announcement. There is no transactional element, stake change, or event affecting shareholders' economic interests. The departure was uncontested and unrelated to any disagreement, making this a routine corporate governance matter.
